story.p1: LacaStay started with a simple observation: the phone rings when you're busiest. Every missed call is a customer who found someone else.
story.p2: We built an AI receptionist that answers in under a second, books into your real calendar, and never has an off day — at a price a single-location business can actually afford.
story.p3: Today LacaStay serves nail salons, spas, and vacation rentals around the world. Our mission is global: every local business — in any country, in any language — deserves a front desk that never misses.
story.title: Our story

values.title: What we stand for
values.v1d: The AI identifies itself on every call. Pricing is public. No hidden fees, no fine print.
values.v2d: TCPA, 10DLC, AI disclosure, and privacy laws aren't an afterthought — they're built into the product and our legal pages.
values.v3d: We design for the independent owner with one to ten locations — not the enterprise chain. Fair pricing, no long contracts.
